_note: X (Twitter) poster configuration. Uses a headed browser + a cookie jar to post through x.com/compose/post.
_note_cookiesFile: Cookie jar for x.com, captured from the local Chrome profile by lib/x-cookie-capture.js. Netscape format. SECRET — it is a live session for a real account, and it lives outside the repo on purpose (see .gitignore).
_note_userDataDir: Browser profile for the X poster. Separate from the MJ (9444), IG (9445) and YouTube (9446) profiles so no two automations fight over one Chromium instance.
_note_browserBin: Browser binary. MUST run headed — X refuses to compose in headless Chromium.

chrome._note_debugPort: CDP port for the X poster. Must differ from MJ's 9444, IG's 9445 and YouTube's 9446.
